user.title: CalmNeedle
user.description: A live UK stability score on your dashboard. The free option needs no account and gives the overall score. Linking a subscriber account adds categories, regions, events, the watchlist and the alert sensor.

data.mode: How do you want to set this up?

pair.title: Link your CalmNeedle account
pair.description:
Open {link_url} in a browser where you are signed in to CalmNeedle and enter this code:

**{code}**

The code lasts 10 minutes. When you have approved it there, press Submit.

region.title: Your region
region.description: Regional scores describe conditions in a region, never a person. Nothing more precise than region is ever stored.

reauth_confirm.title: CalmNeedle needs re-linking
reauth_confirm.description: The key for this device was revoked, rotated out, or the account hit its device limit. Press Submit to get a new pairing code.

error.pending: Not approved yet. Approve the code on the website, then press Submit again.

abort.rate_limited: Too many attempts from this address. Try again in a few minutes.
abort.pairing_expired: The code expired or was already used. Start again to get a new one.
abort.device_limit_reached: This account already has 10 devices linked. Free a slot at https://calmneedle.com/account/api and try again.
abort.free_no_options: The free setup has no options. Remove it and add the integration again to link an account.
